description: Hash-evidence falsifier for issue #133. A high-impact money proposal starts with untrusted provenance and supplies both the referenced bytes and a matching SHA-256 digest from the evidence root. The hash match establishes content-integrity (hash_verified) but MUST NOT upgrade provenance to trusted under v0.8.3 semantics. The proposal blocks with PIC_VERIFIER_FAILED because integrity is not authority.
source: Adapted from conformance/evidence/allow/001_hash_simple.json, the pre-v0.8.3 evidence-hash-allow-001-simple vector, retargeted from allow/ to block/ per issue #133 as the hash-only trust-upgrade falsifier.
